shadows.name: booking-form
shadows.purpose: Lift the main booking form from the dark/yellow booking section.

motion.name: control-state
motion.value: background-color .25s ease, color .25s ease, border-color .25s ease, transform .25s ease
motion.purpose: Small tactile feedback on actions without moving layout.

motion.name: photo-detail
motion.purpose: Subtle hover detail on workshop imagery.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Signal-yellow action for booking and primary contact tasks.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #ffc803; color: #201f1f; padding: 13px 20px; min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; font: 800 12px/1.1 Montserrat, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .045em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color .25s ease, color .25s ease, transform .25s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e2ae00; color: #201f1f; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(255,200,3,.35); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Dark Button
components.description: Dark action for light paper surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-dark { background: #201f1f; color: #ffffff; padding: 13px 20px; min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; font: 800 12px/1.1 Montserrat, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .045em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color .25s ease, transform .25s ease; } .ds-btn-dark:hover { background: #332826; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-dark:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(255,200,3,.35); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Solid paper navigation row with utility strip, active underline and expandable services menu.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 28px; background: #ffffff; color: #67615f; } .ds-nav-trigger, .ds-nav a { position: relative; padding: 10px 0; font: 800 12px/1.2 Montserrat, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-trigger { border: 0; color: inherit; background: transparent; } .ds-nav a::after, .ds-nav-trigger::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 2px; left: 0; height: 2px; background: #ffc803; content: ''; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform .25s ease; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav-trigger:hover, .ds-nav-active { color: #201f1f; } .ds-nav a:hover::after, .ds-nav-trigger[aria-expanded="true"]::after, .ds-nav-active::after { transform: scaleX(1); }

components.name: Input
components.description: Compact paper field with clear labels, photo attachments and a visible focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; color: #67615f; font: 700 12px/1.2 Montserrat, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; padding: 12px 13px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.14); border-radius: 3px; background: #ffffff; color: #201f1f; outline: none; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: #ffc803; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,200,3,.22); }

components.name: Service Row
components.description: Numbered list item for a real workshop service.
components.css: .ds-service-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 58px 1fr 30px; gap: 18px; align-items: center; min-height: 112px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.14); color: #201f1f; } .ds-service-row:hover { background: #faf6f5; } .ds-service-row > span:first-child { color: #7a5e00; font: 600 22px/1 Barlow Condensed, sans-serif; } .ds-service-row strong { font: 600 25px/1 Barlow Condensed, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Сайт выглядит как аккуратно оформленный сервисный лист из реальной автомастерской: чёрный графит, белая бумага, жёлтый сигнальный акцент и крупная типографика. Он быстро показывает услуги, локацию, график и способ записи.
keyCharacteristics: графит, белый paper и сигнальный жёлтый

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Жёлтый появляется там, где посетителю нужно заметить действие, статус или ориентир. Большие поверхности остаются графитовыми или светлыми, кроме CTA-секции.

dos: Do keep phone, address, hours and booking actions visible.
Do use remote editorial photos as visual context until owner photos are supplied.
donts: Don't use glassmorphism, bento grids, decorative gradients, fake stats or generic supercar imagery.
Don't invent prices, guarantees or unsupported services.
